description: This file defines TypeScript types and functions for managing Language Server Protocol (LSP) configurations within a plugin system, including loading, resolving, and inspecting LSP server configurations and runtime support.

methods.name: extractLspServerMap
methods.description: Extracts a map of LSP server configurations from raw input.

methods.name: resolveBundleLspConfigPaths
methods.description: Resolves configuration file paths for LSP servers based on raw config and root directory.

methods.name: loadBundleLspConfigFile
methods.description: Loads an LSP configuration from a specified file.

methods.name: loadBundleLspConfig
methods.description: Loads the complete LSP configuration for a given plugin and bundle format.
